$comment: Per-declaration assurance for Broiler.Plate. Product projects only: the Broiler.Plate.Windows.Tests suite under src/tests and the eng/ and scripts/ tooling are not listed, so they are not covered. src/Broiler.App/WindowsClipboard.cs has no project of its own and is covered through the literal <Compile Include> in the Windows head; it is a vendored first-party copy of the file the Browser, Writer and Code heads also carry. No source here is third-party-derived and nothing is generated, so there are no excludes and no spdxOverrides.
regenerateCommand: dotnet run --project Broiler.Code/src/Broiler.Code.Review.Cli -c Release -- assurance generate --root Broiler.Plate
